what_they_said: Biggest problem this season: no rain and harsh sun. Would field maps and accounts help? Yes. Labour is hired, not family: women for sowing, weeding and harvest at Rs 600/day; spraying needs 2 men at the same rate. Water: rain-fed; a well with little water, groundwater falling; canal water used for a few days recently. A crop-damage panchnama was done 2-3 years ago.
notes: Answers given through my father (second-hand for other farmers). Farmers asked that names not be used.
